title: Air Conditioner Maintenance in Olmos Park, TX
desc: If you're in need of an air conditioner maintenance in Olmos Park, TX, call the experts today to schedule service. We have tune-up plans!

blocks.text: Rosenberg Plumbing & Air provides annual AC maintenance checkups for homes in Olmos Park, TX. We’ve been supporting local homeowners with trusted services since 2003. Residents in the San Antonio area know what a hot summer feels like. Our team is available to ensure your system will keep you cool and comfortable. As an accredited HVAC company with the Better Business Bureau, we also maintain an A+ rating with them. Plus, our company has been a NextDoor Neighborhood Fave four years in a row.
There’s no doubt about the quality we know how to provide for our customers. When you call for services, you’ll speak to one of us directly and not a recording.
We offer our customers:Affordable ratesAward-winning servicesCertified techniciansFlexible appointment scheduling

The technicians we send to you are NATE-certified and fully qualified to serve you. They can conduct complete air conditioner maintenance services on all makes and models. No matter what type of equipment you currently own, we’ll be able to inspect it for you. Once we understand its condition, we can provide you with a complete rundown on any required upkeep. We always treat our customers’ property with respect and care. With help from our skilled team, your air conditioner can last a long time.
Start your summer off with an AC inspection. It’s the best way to know what shape your equipment is in. We know you want your indoor air system to run at optimal levels.
An annual tune-up includes:Calibrating and cleaning the thermostatChecking the filterCleaning electrical connectionsLubricating the motorTesting supply and return pressureTightening belts

If you want to save a little money, become a member of our Comfort Club. Members enjoy twice-a-year system checkups and an email reminder to schedule their appointment. Your air conditioner maintenance services will happen when it’s convenient for you. You’ll also receive a 15% savings on parts and labor for the year and reduced service fees. Added to all of that is a one-year warranty on all parts and labor when work is necessary.

We can help you address long-standing cooling issues and keep your equipment clean and ready for use. Ask us about inspecting your high-tech products, ductless units, and central air conditioners. Call Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today to find out more about the AC maintenance services we offer folks in Olmos Park.
Not looking for AC maintenance? We also offer AC installation and HVAC repair, as well as heating maintenance.
